title: AMG One vs Aston Martin Valkyrie: The Real Difference
description:
Two hypercars, both limited to exactly two hundred seventy-five cars. One has a Formula One engine, a turbocharged V six with a hybrid system. The other has a naturally aspirated V twelve that Wikipedia says makes about a thousand horsepower on its own. One came from Mercedes, the other from Aston Martin and Red Bull. This is the real difference between the Mercedes-AMG One and the Aston Martin Valkyrie. Here is the twist. Both were built in the same number, two hundred seventy-five. Both were late. Both cost about the same order of money. Yet the two engines could hardly be more different, and the Valkyrie's own sources disagree about how much it weighs, by more than three hundred kilograms. We will go through the numbers, and say where they conflict.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
